Ranbir Kapoor described how Amitabh Bachchan once reacted to his decision to leave medicine for acting. Kapoor told Bachchan that the choice felt like 'Bhagwan ka prescription tha Sir.'

Kapoor also spoke about Bachchan's practice he called aura farming, recalled a childhood memory, and said portraying Lord Ram shaped him as a better person. He added that his daughter Raha starts her day with Bachchan's Hanuman Chalisa.

The KBC 18 discussion included an emotional response from Sai Pallavi, according to the report. The exchange centered on her decision to pursue acting.
